tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background for READMEs, presentations and diagram grounds.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, diagram nodes and table bodies; sits on bg.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Table header rows and quiet panels on surface.

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: Inline code background and the Source panel in diagrams.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders (decorative, not a 3:1 control border).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Header and card rules. Light value is 1.45:1 on bg: decoration only; use stroke-* tokens for diagram outlines.

tokens.name: ink-primary
tokens.usage: Headings and node names on bg and surface.

tokens.name: ink-body
tokens.usage: Paragraph text on bg, surface and surface-muted.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and captions on bg, surface (4.76:1) and surface-alt (4.55:1). Also the Source outline.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholder and disabled marks only. 2.56:1 on surface in light: never for text people must read.

tokens.name: accent-navy
tokens.usage: Headings h1-h3 and the cross-cutting controls outline on bg. Dark value is derived (source has no dark theme).

tokens.name: accent-blue
tokens.usage: Kicker text, links and the Serving outline on bg. Dark value is derived.

tokens.name: accent-amber
tokens.usage: Warning marks and borders. Light value is 3.19:1 on white: never body text. Dark value from the Excalidraw palette.

tokens.name: accent-green
tokens.usage: Success marks and PASS badges. Light value is 3.30:1 on white: pair with a word or icon, never colour alone. Dark value from the Databricks terminal theme.

tokens.name: accent-gold
tokens.usage: Emphasis marks. Light value is 2.94:1 on white: borders and fills only. Dark value from the Databricks terminal theme.

tokens.name: brand-orange
tokens.usage: Databricks brand mark colour (from the terminal theme). 3.62:1 on white: large type and graphics only; dark text on it is 4.76:1.

tokens.name: tier-ingest-bg
tokens.usage: Ingest pill fill.

tokens.name: tier-ingest-ink
tokens.usage: Ingest pill text on tier-ingest-bg.

tokens.name: tier-bronze-bg
tokens.usage: Bronze pill fill. Near-identical to tier-gold-bg in the source: do not rely on it to tell Bronze from Gold; use medallion-* in diagrams.

tokens.name: tier-bronze-ink
tokens.usage: Bronze pill text on tier-bronze-bg.

tokens.name: tier-silver-bg
tokens.usage: Silver pill fill.

tokens.name: tier-silver-ink
tokens.usage: Silver pill text on tier-silver-bg.

tokens.name: tier-gold-bg
tokens.usage: Gold pill fill.

tokens.name: tier-gold-ink
tokens.usage: Gold pill text on tier-gold-bg.

tokens.name: tier-gov-bg
tokens.usage: Security pill fill.

tokens.name: tier-gov-ink
tokens.usage: Security pill text on tier-gov-bg.

tokens.name: tier-serving-bg
tokens.usage: Serving pill fill.

tokens.name: tier-serving-ink
tokens.usage: Serving pill text on tier-serving-bg.

tokens.name: medallion-bronze-fill
tokens.usage: Bronze layer panel in diagrams. Copper-tan, clearly not yellow.

tokens.name: medallion-bronze-stroke
tokens.usage: Bronze outline; 5.23:1 on bg light, 6.10:1 dark.

tokens.name: medallion-bronze-ink
tokens.usage: Bronze label text on medallion-bronze-fill (8.88:1 light, 9.48:1 dark).

tokens.name: medallion-silver-fill
tokens.usage: Silver layer panel in diagrams.

tokens.name: medallion-silver-stroke
tokens.usage: Silver outline; 4.27:1 on bg light, 6.98:1 dark.

tokens.name: medallion-silver-ink
tokens.usage: Silver label text on medallion-silver-fill (9.73:1 light, 10.40:1 dark).

tokens.name: medallion-gold-fill
tokens.usage: Gold layer panel in diagrams. Yellow, lighter and greener than bronze.

tokens.name: medallion-gold-stroke
tokens.usage: Gold outline; 3.72:1 on bg light, 8.55:1 dark.

tokens.name: medallion-gold-ink
tokens.usage: Gold label text on medallion-gold-fill (8.31:1 light, 10.21:1 dark).

tokens.name: medallion-serving-fill
tokens.usage: Serving panel in diagrams (same as tier-serving-bg).

tokens.name: medallion-serving-stroke
tokens.usage: Serving outline; 5.03:1 on bg light, 6.67:1 dark.

tokens.name: medallion-serving-ink
tokens.usage: Serving label text on medallion-serving-fill (9.43:1 light, 11.00:1 dark).

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
families.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrow above a title, in accent-blue.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Document title, accent-navy. The source clamps 24px to 34px.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: h2, accent-navy, with a line rule above.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Paragraphs and list items, ink-body. 15px on the page root.

styles.name: node-name
styles.usage: Table or component name inside a diagram node, ink-primary.

styles.name: node-sub
styles.usage: One-line description under a node name, ink-muted.

styles.name: kpi-value
styles.usage: Headline metric in a KPI card.

styles.name: kpi-label
styles.usage: Label under a KPI value, ink-muted.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline code on surface-muted, table and column names.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and small controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked diagram nodes and card grids.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap in KPI grids; heading margin below.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding and section gaps.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutter.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Hero side padding and h2 top margin.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Inline code and chips.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Diagram nodes, pills, quote blocks.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and tables.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Hero bottom corners and diagram layer panels.

tokens.name: shadow-hero
tokens.usage: Hero header: barely there.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: KPI cards.
